MJBL mTLS platform suite (the live deployed ecosystem on this host, indexing the /home/mjbl/* runbooks as source-of-truth): mjbl-mtls-platform, mjbl-ca-operations, mjbl-enrollment-plane, mjbl-client-provisioning, mjbl-cert-lifecycle, mjbl-operator-portal, mjbl-mtls-troubleshooting. Slash commands: /k8s-setup, /harbor-setup, /cicd-setup, and the MJBL suite under /mjbl:mtls:* (platform, ca, enroll, client, cert, portal, troubleshoot, issue-server). MJBL Kubernetes estate suite (the live multi-cluster topology — production rkek8s, the facility/ArgoCD cluster, UAT, and DR — kubeconfigs, MetalLB, ArgoCD external-cluster deploys, and the kubectl-apply DR tooling): mjbl-k8s-platform, mjbl-k8s-production, mjbl-k8s-facility, mjbl-k8s-dr, under /mjbl:k8s:* (platform, prod, facility, dr). Cloudflare developer tooling: cloudflare-worker-scaffold (instantly scaffold an opinionated, local-dev-first TypeScript + Hono Worker with selectable pre-wired bindings — Hyperdrive+Postgres, D1, KV, R2 — bundled-offline or via C3), exposed as the /cf-scaffold slash command. MJBL internal LLM platform: mjbl-llm-platform (the staff AI assistant + MaaS gateway on the facility cluster — one hostname serving Open WebUI at / and an OpenAI-compatible API at /v1, the yanmaru/shinkhoun/noy/kanshin/phima model aliases on the LM Studio rig, AD login, model-scoped API keys, the bge-m3 retrieval posture, and the silent-failure traps), exposed as the /mjbl:llm:platform slash command.
